goal: Build official Linux release executables as static binaries instead of dynamically linking glibc
Run release binaries on non-glibc distributions like Alpine or NixOS and systems with older glibcs
Enable security mitigations like aarch64 pointer authentication that require static linking
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now, with nothing known that would invalidate review of the current code
agreement: Broad support for static-pie over musl to cleanly improve distribution portability (theuni, willcl-ark)
Verified by testing binaries on Alpine, NixOS, Fedora, and Ubuntu (0xB10C, jsarenik, dergoegge, theStack)
Unaddressed objection: dynamic NSS resolvers break across glibc versions, no author reply (luke-jr)
Suggestion to log lookup failures when dynamic NSS resolution fails (xrviv)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it substantially improves Linux binary portability across varied distributions
Users can run release binaries on Alpine, NixOS, and older systems without compatibility shims
It unblocks future security hardening mitigations such as aarch64 pointer authentication
